transport_rule: Reuse exact fixed-target recovered identities/bytes when already available; generation/hash/view/exit0 adds reading0. If absent restore only fixed C paths into own inert subdirectory, verify collection/mode/blob/bytes/SHA; never root cache/another author directory.
record_semantics_rule: Each source literal including complete ordered lists/repeats/prose and all explicit/omitted/default/inherited meanings must actually be displayed and understood. Lossless reversible views allowed; producing a view gives0 credit; truncation requires repair.

independence.actual: UNVERIFIED until authoritative echoes; never infer from request

closure.local: All owned record values/fields/defaults and all owned atomic/header/interface facts fully received with necessary source/current formal and actual nonauthor evidence, or exact INCOMPLETE remainder.
closure.shared: Incoming peers only gate corresponding cross-generation full-interface closure; finish independent own primary work without waiting. Parent reads exact complete receipts and performs cumulative joins.
closure.root: Only main thread signs canonical/task-final. No shard global PASS, no automatic aggregation to acceptance.
closure.behavior_execution: NOT_EXECUTED unless actually observed safely and separately recorded
